claims: The CDC recommends an annual flu vaccine for everyone 6 months and older, ideally by the end of October.
Standard-dose Shots are available for people 6 months and older.
High-dose & Adjuvanted Shots are specifically for adults 65 and older to create a stronger immune response.
Recombinant & Cell-based Shots are completely egg-free options.
Nasal Spray (FluMist) is a live attenuated vaccine approved for healthy, non-pregnant individuals aged 2 through 49.
It takes about two weeks for protection to develop after vaccination.
Flu vaccines are available at doctors' offices, clinics, pharmacies, and health departments.
Flu vaccines are safe and cannot cause the flu.
Children 6 months through 8 years may require two doses in one season.
For the 2023-2024 season, all flu vaccines in the U.S. are designed to protect against four strains of the virus.
